source_text: Ἠρώτηται μὲν γὰρ ἡδέως ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν καὶ σωτὴρ ἐρώτημα καταλληλότατον αὐτῷ, ἡ ζωὴ περὶ ζωῆς, ὁ σωτὴρ περὶ σωτηρίας. ὁ διδάσκαλος περὶ κεφαλαίου [οὐ τῶν διδασκομένων δογμάτων. ἡ ἀλήθεια περὶ τῆς ἀληθινῆς ἀθανασίας, ὁ λόγος περὶ τοῦ πατρῴου λόγου. ὁ τέλειος περὶ τῆς τελείας ἀναπαύσεως, ὁ ἄφθαρτος περὶ τῆς βεβαίας ἀφθαρσίας. ἠρώτηται περὶ τούτων ὑπὲρ ὧν καὶ κατελήλυθεν. ἃ παιδεύει. ἃ διδάσκει. ἃ παρέχει, ἵνα δείξῃ τὴν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ὑπόθεσιν. ὅτι δόσις ἐστὶν αἰωνίου ζωῆς. πρόοιδε δὲ ὡς θεὸς καὶ ἃ μέλλει διερωτηθήσεσθαι καὶ ἃ μέλλει τις αὐτῷ ἀποκρίνεσθαι. τίς γὰρ καὶ μᾶλλον ἣ ὁ προφήτης προφητῶν καὶ κύριος παντὸς προφητικοῦ πνεύματος; κληθεὶς δὲ ἀγαθός. ἀπ᾿ αὐτοῦ πρώτου τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου τὸ ἐνδόσιμον λαβὼν ἐντεῦθεν καὶ τῆς διδασκαλίας ἄρχεται, ἐπιστρέφων τὸν μαθητὴν ἐπὶ τὸ θεὸν τὸν ἀγαθὸν καὶ πρῶτον καὶ μόνον ζωῆς αἰωνίου ταμίαν, ἣν ὁ υἱὸς δίδωσιν ἡμῖν παρ᾿ ἐκείνου λαβών.
thought_title: The fitting question: life asks about life
orientation: Clement is introducing the Gospel dialogue, explaining that the rich man's question to Jesus was perfectly suited to who Jesus is.
pass_a_gloss: For our Lord and Savior has been asked, gladly, a question most fitting for him: life about life, the Savior about salvation. The teacher about the chief point of the doctrines being taught. The truth about true immortality, the Word about the paternal Word. The perfect one about perfect rest, the incorruptible one about secure incorruptibility. He has been asked about these things for which he also came down. Which he teaches. Which he instructs. Which he provides, in order that he might show the substance of the gospel: that it is a gift of eternal life. And he knows beforehand, as God, both what things he is about to be asked and what things someone is about to answer him. For who more than the prophet of prophets and lord of every prophetic spirit? And having been called good, taking from this very word first the starting point, from there he also begins the teaching, turning the disciple toward God, the good and first and only steward of eternal life, which the Son gives to us, having received it from him.

choices.why: Keeps the wordplay of the Greek, where the same noun serves as subject and object of the preposition

choices.term: ὁ λόγος περὶ τοῦ πατρῴου λόγου
choices.english: the Word about the paternal Word
choices.why: Preserves the double sense of λόγος as both Christ the Word and the subject of the question
rejected: the reason about the fatherly reason
the discourse about the fatherly discourse

choices.why: Renders the office of one who dispenses or administers a store, fitting the image of God as source of eternal life
The word means a musical keynote or signal; 'starting point' captures the sense of a cue from which the teaching begins
ὑπόθεσις here means the underlying subject or theme, not a hypothesis; 'substance' conveys the foundational content

pass_b_english: Our Lord and Savior has been asked a question that suits him perfectly: Life is asked about life, the Savior about salvation, the Teacher about the chief point of the doctrines he teaches, the Truth about true immortality, the Word about the paternal Word, the Perfect One about perfect rest, the Incorruptible about sure incorruptibility. He has been asked about the very things he came down to teach and to give, so that he might show the substance of the gospel: that it is the gift of eternal life. As God, he knew beforehand what he would be asked and what answer someone would give him. Who else would know this better than the Prophet of prophets and Lord of every prophetic spirit? When he was called good, he took his starting point from that very word and began his teaching there, turning the disciple toward God, who is good and first and the only steward of eternal life, which the Son gives us after receiving it from him.

last_rejected.quote: the only steward of eternal life
last_rejected.source_quote: τὸν θεὸν τὸν ἀγαθὸν καὶ πρῶτον καὶ μόνον ζωῆς αἰωνίου ταμίαν
last_rejected.why: ταμίαν means “treasure,” not “steward”; the translation changes God’s role from being the treasure of eternal life to a steward, altering the meaning.
last_rejected.fix: the good, first and only treasure of eternal life
last_rejected.ruling: ταμίας means steward/dispenser/treasurer; 'steward' is within normal range, not 'treasure.' No meaning change.
